conditions.description: Liquidazione Iva trimestrale, allowed below the turnover limits.

profileFields.label: Denominazione
profileFields.description: The company name, with S.r.l. or S.r.l.s.

profileFields.label: REA number
profileFields.description: The number in the Chamber of Commerce's economic and administrative index.

profileFields.label: Codice fiscale and partita IVA
profileFields.description: The company's tax code; for a company it is usually also the VAT number.

profileFields.label: Capitale sociale
profileFields.description: In euros, as in the deed of incorporation.

roles.label: Amministratore
roles.description: Runs the company, alone or as a board.

roles.label: Socio
roles.description: Holds a quota of the capital.

setupSteps.title: Sign the deed of incorporation before a notary
setupSteps.description: The company is formed by public deed (atto pubblico) drawn up by a notary.

setupSteps.title: Pay in the capital
setupSteps.description: The capital can be as low as 1 euro. Below 10,000 euros, contributions are in cash and paid in full to the directors; from 10,000 euros, at least 25% is paid at incorporation.

setupSteps.title: Registration with the Registro delle Imprese
setupSteps.description: The notary files the deed with the Registro delle Imprese of the province of the registered office, through the Comunicazione Unica, which also reaches the Agenzia delle Entrate and the social security bodies. Check the filing deadline with the notary.

setupSteps.title: Get a PEC address
setupSteps.description: A company has a certified email address registered with the Registro delle Imprese.

setupSteps.title: Start the activity with the SUAP
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a notice (SCIA) or a permit from the municipality's SUAP before starting.

setupSteps.title: Open the company bank account
setupSteps.description: Used for the capital and for paying taxes with F24.

setupSteps.title: Appoint an accountant (commercialista)
setupSteps.description: Agree who keeps the books and files the returns.

obligations.title: VAT settlement and payment, monthly
obligations.description: Settle and pay the VAT for the previous month with F24 by the 16th.

obligations.title: VAT payment, first quarter
obligations.description: Quarterly payers pay the first quarter by 16 May, with 1% interest added.

obligations.title: VAT payment, second quarter
obligations.description: Quarterly payers pay the second quarter by 20 August.

obligations.title: VAT payment, third quarter
obligations.description: Quarterly payers pay the third quarter by 16 November; the fourth goes with the annual balance.

obligations.title: Periodic VAT settlement report (LIPE)
obligations.description: Sent online by the last day of the second month after each quarter. The second quarter's is due by 30 September instead (later than the date shown), and the fourth can go with the annual VAT return.

obligations.title: Annual VAT balance
obligations.description: Pay the VAT due on the annual return by 16 March, at once or in instalments.

obligations.title: Annual VAT return
obligations.description: Sent online between 1 February and 30 April of the next year.

obligations.title: Income tax return (Redditi SC)
obligations.description: Sent online by the last day of the 10th month after the tax period ends (31 October for a calendar year).

obligations.title: Shareholders approve the financial statements
obligations.description: Within 120 days of the year end, or 180 days where the articles allow it.

obligations.title: File the financial statements
obligations.description: The directors file them with the Registro delle Imprese within 30 days of approval (30 May after a 120-day approval).

obligations.title: Chamber of Commerce annual fee (diritto annuale)
obligations.description: Paid by the date of the first income-tax instalment: 30 June in 2026. A different date can apply; check your Chamber of Commerce.
